Register for the first WCA Speedcubing Competition in Paarl, near Cape Town, South Africa!

**COVID-19 Safety Measures**
While it is no longer a national requirement to wear a face mask or practice social distancing, we encourage you to sanitize regularly and be respectful of personal space. If you are comfortable wearing a mask, please do so!

**Volunteering**
We will need your help as volunteers to support with the running and judging of the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact [Maverick Pearson](mpearson@worldcubeassociation.org). Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing.

**Cube Shop**
Cape Town's own cube shop, [Speedcubes.co.za](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/), will have a stall open at the competition to sell a variety of puzzles. Check out their website to see what's available! 

**Zero-waste Tuck Shop**
There will be a tuck shop open near the school hall with healthy and tasty snacks, coffee, and drinks. There will also be a lunch option that can be booked beforehand. We will share the link to this booking closer to the day via email.
